_doc_1: gh-release-sampler config. Only the .targets array is read; keys starting with _ are ignored and serve as documentation.
_doc_2: Each entry is a string in one of two forms:
_doc_3: "owner"       -> every non-archived repo of that user OR org that has releases (resolved via 'gh repo list')
_doc_5: Users and organizations both work. There is deliberately no include/exclude filtering: the sampler collects everything, and gh-stats does the fine-grained filtering at query time (--owner/--repo/--tag/--major/--assets/--stable/--latest ...).
